items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: The interviewee responds to the name 'Dr. Sieglin Spieth' by immediately shifting the topic to a 'publicity man' and childhood memories, without mentioning any personal interaction, relationship, or specific knowledge of Dr. Sieglin Spieth.

ctx.x: Oh, and this guy, this publicity man, he used to write up some weird tales. People would think I was queer. I mean, you know, I mean, not queer, but... Very strange. We got to the automobile show every year. Okay, huh? Now, this is when I was a little tarp. I was just a little boy. School of Tate Larry. I played trumpet. See what that came in? See my brother played in the school orchestra? This is Cornet Soul. I played in after years when you grow old. Now you know what they're talking about. You see?
